Maya: Heads-up — we're planning a refactor of the console analytics storage schema this week. Goal: make per-org per-route latency and quota queries O(1).

Dan: How will this affect existing dashboards and the console telemetry API? Any breaking changes?

Maya: No breaking changes to public console APIs. Internal tables change:
```
-- new sharded table
CREATE TABLE analytics.events_shard (
  org_id UUID,
  route_id VARCHAR,
  ts TIMESTAMP,
  latency_ms INT,
  tokens_used INT,
  metadata JSON
) PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(ts) PRIMARY KEY (org_id, route_id, ts);

-- view to maintain compatibility
CREATE VIEW analytics.events AS SELECT * FROM analytics.events_shard WHERE 1=1;
```

Maya: We'll backfill last 30 days into events_shard. Migration window: Wed 03/18 00:00 UTC -> Wed 03/25 23:59 UTC. Backfill job will be throttled and run from replica to avoid primary load.

Alice: I'll ping the dashboard owners and product-console. Need to ensure saved queries referencing `service` column are aliased -> route_id.

Seán: Can we do org-level canary routing? We don't want to flip all customers at once.

Maya: Yes — plan: 5% orgs -> 25% -> 100% over 48 hours. Feature flag toggle per org in FF-service. We'll monitor latency and query failures.

Ben: infra note: backfill will spike OLAP IO. Recommend pre-warming an extra compute node and setting backfill concurrency=4. Throttle to 2k rows/s per node. Also put a QoS rule to avoid disturbing realtime ingest.

infra-bot: Alert: current clickhouse CPU at 42% (nominal). Will auto-scale if >70% for 5m :gear:

Maya: Ops runbook in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PLAT/pages/ANALYTICS-MIGRATION

deploy-bot: snapshot created: migration-1769123456

Dan: Thanks — can we get a minimal migration checklist? I'll add to my PR.

Maya: Checklist (short):
- announce to console & product
- rename column aliases in views
- schedule backfill job
- enable org canary flag
- monitor dashboards + error rates

Dan: I'll take dashboard coordination.

Alice: +1. I'll coordinate product owners and tag saved queries for quick fixes.

Maya: :shipit: Starting prep tomorrow. Will post progress updates in this thread.
